note: Read by tools/restructure/browser-move.mjs. `homes`: the folder of a feature when it is not named like the feature (as in move-left.json). `features` and `files`: loose scripts of server/js/ that stay where they are on purpose, each with the reason the report prints. `lists`: scripts whose strings are the addresses of a page the engine writes when the page is asked for, so they are rewritten with a move like a script tag. `outside`: file names that code outside this repo (Xenon Maker, the creator and hub skills) reads: it looks for `server/js/<name>` and then for the one `server/js/*/<name>`, so each lives once, in the root or exactly one folder down, and the check refuses a second place. `copies`: scripts Xenon Maker keeps a copy of and compares byte for byte with this repo: a move never writes into one (a note in it keeps the address of its day), and one moves only when every path it loads stays true.

features.engine-core: a shared root: every page and every feature loads it, and it belongs to none
features.words: a shared root: every page and every feature loads it, and it belongs to none (Xenon Maker also reads i18n.js by this path)
features.helpers-shared: a shared root: every page and every feature loads it, and it belongs to none

files.server/js/main.js: the script every page starts from; `js/main.js` is also the name widget packages give their own entry, and the two cannot be told apart in a note or a test
files.server/js/ambient-scene.js: Xenon Maker keeps a copy of it that must stay the same byte for byte, and it loads `./dashboard-instances.js`, a script of the grid: in the folder of its own feature that line would be written again
files.server/js/dashboard-instances.js: ambient-scene.js loads it as `./dashboard-instances.js` and must not change by a byte (Xenon Maker keeps a copy): the two stay side by side
files.server/js/custom-bg.js: Xenon Maker keeps a copy of it that must stay the same byte for byte, and it loads `./look/bg-guard.js`: from inside look/ that line would be written again
